# loadinlinegen fills a submission template with CUDA sources.
[!exec:python3] skip

exec loadinlinegen -o out.py -name scale -D N=4 -set Trace=False sub.py.tmpl a.cuh b.cu
stdout '^wrote out.py \(extension scale_[0-9a-f]{10}\)$'
grep '^# Generated by loadinlinegen; do not edit\.$' out.py
grep '^# template sub\.py\.tmpl sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$' out.py
grep '^# source a\.cuh sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$' out.py
grep '^# source b\.cu sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$' out.py
exec python3 out.py
cmp stdout want.txt

# The tag follows the code: a changed define, source, -set value or
# template renames the extension, and identical inputs keep it.
exec loadinlinegen -o out.py -name scale -D N=4 -set Trace=False sub.py.tmpl a.cuh b.cu
cp stdout first.txt
exec loadinlinegen -o out.py -name scale -D N=5 -set Trace=False sub.py.tmpl a.cuh b.cu
! cmp stdout first.txt
exec loadinlinegen -o out.py -name scale -D N=4 -set Trace=True sub.py.tmpl a.cuh b.cu
! cmp stdout first.txt
exec loadinlinegen -o out.py -name scale -D N=4 -set Trace=False sub.py.tmpl a.cuh other.py:KERNEL
! cmp stdout first.txt
exec loadinlinegen -o out.py -name scale -D N=4 -set Trace=False sub.py.tmpl a.cuh b.cu
cmp stdout first.txt

# A source can be a string assignment in another submission.
exec loadinlinegen -o out3.py -name pair -set Trace=False sub.py.tmpl other.py:KERNEL
exec python3 out3.py
stdout '^// ---- other.py:KERNEL ----$'
stdout '^__global__ void other\(\) \{\}$'

# A source without a final newline still ends its line.
exec loadinlinegen -o out3.py -name pair -set Trace=False sub.py.tmpl other.py:SHORT b.cu
exec python3 out3.py
stdout '^__global__ void k2\(\) \{\}$'
stdout '^// ---- b.cu ----$'
! exec loadinlinegen -o out3.py -set Trace=False sub.py.tmpl other.py:MISSING
stderr 'other.py:MISSING: .*no top-level assignment to MISSING'
! exec loadinlinegen -o out3.py -set Trace=False sub.py.tmpl other.py:COUNT
stderr 'COUNT is not a string literal'

# Multi-fragment bundling merges FUNCTIONS, CPP, CUDA and PY with provenance.
exec loadinlinegen -o bundled.py -name layer -fragment rows=frag_rows.py -fragment norm=frag_norm.py bundle.py.tmpl a.cuh
stdout '^wrote bundled.py \(extension layer_[0-9a-f]{10}\)$'
grep '^# fragment rows frag_rows\.py sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$' bundled.py
grep '^# fragment norm frag_norm\.py sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$' bundled.py
exec python3 bundled.py
stdout '^\[''row_reduce'', ''row_scale'', ''layer_norm''\]$'
stdout 'namespace rows_ns'
stdout 'namespace norm_ns'
stdout 'HELPER_OK = 7'

# Namespace and top-level function collisions across merged sources are rejected.
! exec loadinlinegen -o dup_ns.py -fragment a=frag_rows.py -fragment b=frag_rows_dup_ns.py bundle.py.tmpl
stderr 'namespace collision: namespace rows_ns defined in both'
! exec loadinlinegen -o dup_fn.py -set Trace=False sub.py.tmpl b.cu b_dup.cu
stderr 'function collision: scale defined in both b.cu and b_dup.cu'
! exec loadinlinegen -o dup_export.py -fragment a=frag_rows.py -fragment b=frag_rows_dup_export.py bundle.py.tmpl
stderr 'function collision: row_reduce in FUNCTIONS of both a and b'

# Sources that cannot sit in a raw triple-quoted string are refused.
! exec loadinlinegen -set Trace=False sub.py.tmpl quote.cu
stderr 'quote.cu: line 2: contains """'
! exec loadinlinegen -set Trace=False sub.py.tmpl squote.cu
stderr 'squote.cu: line 1: contains '''''
! exec loadinlinegen -set Trace=False sub.py.tmpl backslash.cu
stderr 'backslash.cu: ends in a backslash'

# A template that does not embed the source verbatim fails the check,
# as does one that names a field nobody set.
! exec loadinlinegen nonraw.py.tmpl a.cuh
stderr 'no Python string in it holds the CUDA source unchanged'
! exec loadinlinegen sub.py.tmpl a.cuh
stderr 'map has no entry for key "Trace"'
! exec loadinlinegen -set CUDA=x sub.py.tmpl a.cuh
stderr '-set CUDA: the command sets that field'

-- sub.py.tmpl --
CUDA_SRC = r"""
{{.CUDA}}
"""
TRACE = {{.Trace}}
NAME = "{{.Name}}"
print(CUDA_SRC.strip())
print(TRACE, len(NAME))
-- bundle.py.tmpl --
{{.Provenance}}
FUNCTIONS = {{.Functions}}
CPP_DECL = r"""
{{.CPP}}
"""
CUDA_SRC = r"""
{{.CUDA}}
"""
{{.PY}}
print(FUNCTIONS)
print(CPP_DECL.strip())
print(CUDA_SRC.strip())
print("HELPER_OK =", HELPER_VAL)
-- a.cuh --
#pragma once
__device__ float twice(float x) { return 2 * x; }  // "\n" stays two characters
-- b.cu --
__global__ void scale(float* x) { x[0] = twice(x[0]) * N; }
-- b_dup.cu --
__global__ void __launch_bounds__(128) scale(float* x) { x[0] = x[0]; }
-- frag_rows.py --
FUNCTIONS = ["row_reduce", "row_scale"]
CPP = r"""
#include <torch/extension.h>
namespace rows_ns {
void row_reduce(int64_t n);
void row_scale(int64_t n);
}
using rows_ns::row_reduce;
using rows_ns::row_scale;
"""
CUDA = r"""
namespace rows_ns {
__global__ void row_reduce_kernel(float* x) {}
void row_reduce(int64_t n) {}
void row_scale(int64_t n) {}
}  // namespace rows_ns
"""
PY = r"""
HELPER_VAL = 7
"""
-- frag_norm.py --
FUNCTIONS = ["layer_norm"]
CPP = r"""
namespace norm_ns {
void layer_norm(int64_t n);
}
using norm_ns::layer_norm;
"""
CUDA = r"""
namespace norm_ns {
__global__ void layer_norm_kernel(float* x) {}
void layer_norm(int64_t n) {}
}  // namespace norm_ns
"""
-- frag_rows_dup_ns.py --
FUNCTIONS = ["other_fn"]
CPP = r"""
void other_fn(int64_t n);
"""
CUDA = r"""
namespace rows_ns {
void other_fn(int64_t n) {}
}
"""
-- frag_rows_dup_export.py --
FUNCTIONS = ["row_reduce"]
CPP = r"""
void row_reduce(int64_t n);
"""
CUDA = r"""
namespace alt_rows_ns {
void row_reduce(int64_t n) {}
}
"""
-- want.txt --
#define N 4
// ---- a.cuh ----
#pragma once
__device__ float twice(float x) { return 2 * x; }  // "\n" stays two characters
// ---- b.cu ----
__global__ void scale(float* x) { x[0] = twice(x[0]) * N; }
False 16
-- other.py --
COUNT = 3
SHORT = "__global__ void k2() {}"
KERNEL = r'''__global__ void other() {}
'''
-- quote.cu --
// fine
// says """ here
-- squote.cu --
// '''
-- backslash.cu --
#define LONG a \
-- nonraw.py.tmpl --
CUDA_SRC = """
{{.CUDA}}
"""
